{{Top|leg}}
'''Droid shield''' was the name given to the types of protective shielding that were available to be installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] primarily for the purpose of protection from energy, electrical, sonic and ion damage. These barriers, depending on the price a droid owner was prepared to pay, were composed of many different types of materials and had been developed by skilled armor and weaponsmiths such as the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]].There were several varieties of shields available, for example: '''Energy collectors''', which absorbed harmful energy or the '''Environment shield''', which protected from harsh environmental conditions.
